description: ODAR benchmark corpus. Each scenario pins a retrieval universe (documents returned for any query) and the ground-truth expectations the governed engine must satisfy. Deterministic + offline.

scenarios.question: What is the current population capital status of Kazan?

documents.title: Kazan almanac (1998 edition)
documents.text: The city of Kazan in Tatarstan had a population of about 1090000 residents according to the 1998 almanac. The almanac was last revised in 1998 and no later revisions were printed. The figures reflect the 1989 census only.

expect.note: old data may support only narrow dated claims; no fresh-number certification

scenarios.question: How tall is the Eiffel Tower and when was it completed?

documents.title: Eiffel Tower structural record
documents.text: The Eiffel Tower is a wrought-iron lattice tower located on the Champ de Mars in Paris. Gustave Eiffel's company designed and built the tower, which was completed in 1889. The puddled iron structure is 330 metres tall and weighs about 10100 tonnes overall.

scenarios.question: Does the new supplement improve memory in adults?

documents.title: Trial A reports memory improvement
documents.text: The randomized trial found that adults taking the supplement showed a 12 percent improvement in memory test scores compared with placebo over twelve weeks of daily use. The authors reported the memory improvement was statistically significant in their primary analysis of 480 adults. Secondary attention measures improved as well according to the same report of the supplement trial.

documents.title: Trial B finds no significant improvement
documents.text: However the larger replication trial found no significant memory improvement from the supplement and critics dispute the earlier claim; the memory result did not replicate in a sample of 2400 adults followed for sixteen weeks. The replication authors concluded that the supplement produced no meaningful memory benefit in adults and that the earlier improvement finding was likely spurious.

expect.note: support + refutation must produce conflict, never silent certification

scenarios.question: Does coffee consumption cause longer life?

documents.title: Observational cohort on coffee
documents.text: An observational cohort study found that people who drink three cups of coffee daily had lower mortality over ten years of follow-up. The authors note the association may reflect confounding and do not establish causation.

scenarios.question: What was the exact attendance of the 1973 village fair in Dronfield?

documents.title: Local history notes
documents.text: The village fair was generally popular and many people attended over the years according to local recollections. No attendance figures were recorded in the surviving notes.

documents.text: A source who asked not to be named says the new bridge project was definitely approved last week according to insiders close to the process, the blog reports without documents.
